title: Hearty Molten Korean Tofu Stew
description: A rich and comforting Korean-inspired stew featuring soy milk and tofu, perfect for a post-workout meal or a cold winter's night, and suitable for a Buddhist temple diet due to its vegetarian ingredients.

ingredients.name: silken tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into small cubes

instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine soy milk, gochujang, gochugaru, garlic, and ginger, and blend until smooth.
Heat the sesame oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the blended soy milk mixture to the saucepan and bring to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the cubed tofu to the saucepan and cook for an additional 5 minutes, or until the tofu is heated through.
Season the stew with salt and black pepper to taste.
Transfer the stew to a sous-vide machine and cook at 160 degrees Fahrenheit for 30 minutes.
Garnish with chopped scallions and serve hot.
